title: Tell your father the school times

scenario.en: Your school sends a message about the new times. Your father asks you what it says.
scenario.ar: المدرسة بعتت رسالة بالمواعيد الجديدة. أبوك سألك بتقول إيه.

source: "School starts at eight o'clock every day. Lunch is at twelve. Students finish at three o'clock."

task.en: Tell your father the three times from the message.
task.ar: قول لأبوك التلات مواعيد اللي في الرسالة.

model_answer.en: School starts at eight, lunch is at twelve, and we finish at three o'clock.
model_answer.ar: المدرسة تبدأ تمانية، الغدا اتناشر، وبنخلص تلاتة.
